title: Neelambari
desc: Reporter Vinod and his crew visit Neela Betta to film a supernatural event, but after interviewing villager Akhila, the entire team mysteriously vanishes.

title: Chellata
desc: Ganesh takes a loan for his sister's marriage, opens a business, and loses money. Soon, a wealthy girl falls in love with him, unaware of his severe debt.

title: Bell Bottom
desc: Divakara aspires to be a detective since his childhood. When he becomes a constable, he finally gets his to solve a robbery case.

title: Lakshya
desc: Abhimanyu triumphs in wrestling, solidifying his career. A fabricated rape accusation threatens to dismantle his success, creating a challenging career crisis.

title: Giri Kanye
desc: An estate manager sets his eyes on a beautiful girl. When he tries to misbehave with her, a good-hearted man comes to her rescue.

title: Aramane
desc: A photographer named Arun befriends Rajashekhara, a wealthy but lonely man who has resorted to drinking to quell his pain. Soon, Arun agrees to help him reunite with his estranged family.

title: Kiragoorina Gayyaligalu
desc: A village living in harmony faces challenges when politicians try to divide the people based on caste. Female villagers take up the job to fight.

title: Hero
desc: An aspiring actor chases his dream of stardom, but personal struggles and unforeseen events threaten his chances of success.

title: Dhumm
desc: The protagonist Varada is in love with his opponent's daughter. But when he learns that his rival has killed his sister, he decides to avenge her death.

title: RajaHamsa
desc: Raj belongs to a wealthy family. He learns about Hamsa through a dead man's personal diary and falls in love with her.

title: Kannad Gothilla
desc: When several non-Kannadiga migrants disappear in Bengaluru, senior inspector Shruthi takes charge. With mounting pressure, she races to identify the abductor and bring him to justice.

title: Kranthi Veera Sangolli Rayanna
desc: Sangolli Rayanna, the brave army chief of Kittur, fights valiantly for freedom. He leads a fierce revolt against British rule to reclaim his nation's lost independence.
